run_make_video_cli: run the CLI tool to create MP4 videos from color and depth image frame directories
create_depth_overlay_video: create a depth overlay video by blending grayscale color frames with depth frames
stack_videos_side_by_side: stack multiple video files horizontally side by side into a single composite video using ffmpeg
create_resized_video: create a resized version of an existing video to a specified width and height tuple
count_frames_in_directory: count the number of image frames with a given file extension in a directory
